description: One record per mention-to-product-category link. A product may only be linked to a mention when a verifiable quote supports it; never inferred from the search query, the task category, or the pilot default. Source: PDT v1.3.1 §6.9.

evidence_id.description: Evidence record (quote + source URL) that supports this link

link_type.description: How the link was established, e.g. quoted_evidence

mention_id.description: The mention this link belongs to

review_status.description: Human review state of this link

title: Mention Product Category Link
